name: Heap
description: Heap is a product analytics platform that "automatically captures every user interaction" so teams always have the data needed to increase conversion, retention, and customer delight.
best_for: Positioned for product teams (activation/conversion/retention), marketing teams (acquisition performance), and data teams (behavioral analysis without coding), with industry solutions for SaaS, retail/ecommerce, healthcare, and financial services.
features: Automatic data capture via a single code snippet (no manual event tagging)
Sense AI/Sense Chat for AI-powered analytics
Integrated session replay with directed navigation to key moments

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform bringing AI into product-building, with experimentation and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing product analytics with feature experimentation.
